title: 3D Gameplay of latest demo game using Claude
author: Traditional-Dish-568
selftext:
a game I tried to “make” with Claude. I don’t really know what to call this   
Claude picked the title   
It’s absolute ass of a title but whatever.   
“The Pickup” ooooo spooky

Anyway this is just gameplay of the first level. Everything might look a bit janky. I wanted to base it off of retro pixel styles. Obviously. Enjoy :p 

The antagonist guy chasing you is named Dean apparently. Might change the name since I already have a character named Dean in another story.   
You are a kid stuck in a play place called starland and are waiting for someone to come and get you. It’s your 7th birthday. You are all alone. There is a man with a knife chasing you.
